title: Yoroiden Samurai Troopers 30th Anniversary Memorial Book
originalTitle: 鎧伝サムライトルーパー　３０周年メモリアルブック
summary: A true memorial book published for the 30th anniversary. The cover is newly drawn by Hideo Okamoto, and the contents include period color illustrations, character introductions, full-episode digest, staff and cast interviews, side stories, character settings, and art settings. The source page calls it essential for fans.
